user.title: Schneider Conext / Insight Home
user.description: Find your gateway automatically or enter its address manually.

menu_options.scan: Scan my network for the gateway

scan.title: Scan for gateway
scan.description: Probe the local network for a Conext gateway on the given Modbus port. Leave the CIDR blank to scan all local subnets.

select.title: Select devices
select.description: Found {count} device(s) on your Conext system. Check the ones you want to use — entities are created only for selected devices. Tick "Add a device" if something is missing.

data.add_device: Add a device that wasn't found

add.title: Add a device
add.description: Manually add a device. Pick its type, the Modbus slave ID it uses, and an optional custom name.

data.name: Custom name (optional)
data.add_another: Add another device after this one

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Conext gateway at that address/port.
error.no_devices_found: No Conext gateway responded on the scanned network.

data_description.scan_interval: How often all other sensors are refreshed (5 – 60 s).
data_description.live_scan_interval: How often the live sensor group is read (1 – 60 s). Keep this as high as possible — polling too fast can overload the gateway.
data_description.fast_keys: These sensors are polled at the live interval above. Selecting too many will slow down every poll and may cause gateway timeouts.
data_description.word_order: Controls how 32-bit register pairs are combined. Use 'little' only if power or voltage readings look wrong.
data_description.scan_cidr: Subnet to scan when the gateway IP changes (e.g. 192.168.50.0/24). Leave blank to scan all local subnets.
